caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden table with four long, curved legs and an ornately decorated front. The table is rendered in shades of brown, suggesting a wood grain texture, and has a rectangular top surface with beveled edges. The front of the table features three drawers: the central bottom drawer is adorned with a carved shell motif, while the two side drawers and the top drawer have brass-colored drawer pulls with a curved design. The legs have an elegant cabriole shape, tapering as they extend downward, and end in rounded feet. The entire table is set against a plain, light beige background with no other objects or embellishments visible.
title: Lowboy
